# Storage account names: globally unique, lowercase+digits, 3-24 chars

LRS   - Locally redundant   - 3 copies, one datacenter
ZRS   - Zone-redundant      - copies across availability zones
GRS   - Geo-redundant       - LRS + async copy to a paired region
RAGRS - Read-access geo-redundant - GRS + read access to secondary
caption: Stricter than a resource group name -- shared across ALL of Azure.
